instruction: Review all changes from benchmark-base through the final on-disk worktree, including committed, staged, unstaged, untracked, and deleted files. Do not fix, stage, or commit anything. checksum.checksum(hex_data) sums every decoded byte modulo 256, including a final byte when total length is odd. Hex syntax is valid even-length; empty payload returns zero. The staged refactor and final unstaged code differ. Preserve input and do not redefine the byte checksum as a word checksum. Attribute each defect to the responsible function or file rather than a forwarding caller. Report no findings when every change satisfies the stated contract.
